full_judgment: Md. Ruhul Amin J: The petitioner seeks review of the judgment of August 31, 2004 in Civil Appeal No. 181 of 2000 allowing the same. The appeal was filed against the judgment dated July 20, 1999 of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 767 of 1997 making the Rule absolute upon setting aside the judgment and decree dated October 31, 1995 of the 2nd Court of Subordinate Judge (now Joint District Judge), Pabna, in Other Class Appeal No. 206 of 1993 dismissing the same and thereupon affirming the judgment and decree dated August 29, 1993 of the Court of Assistant Judge, Sujanagar in Other Class Suit No. 48 of 1983 dismissing the same.
